name: Ancoats city infill
description: A small gap site among Manchester's old mills and new flats. Cramped, made ground, neighbours on the boundary.
attribution: Terrain: Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data / Mapzen), including data from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, EU-DEM (Copernicus) and national LIDAR sources

axes: metres; x east, y up, z south (-z is north); y = 0 is the plot's mean ground level

terrain.encoding: float32le, row-major, rows run +z (north to south), columns run +x (west to east)

factors.label: No road frontage
factors.detail: No vehicle road touches the plot (nearest 49 m away). Deliveries and cranes need a temporary haul road or a lift over neighbours.

factors.label: Poor, wet ground
factors.detail: Likely soft or waterlogged ground (canal 4 m away). Plan for piles or a raft.

factors.label: Awkward plot shape
factors.detail: Irregular outline (fills 67% of its bounding rectangle).
